data.action: 双手背后微倾身从空中缓缓降下，青蓝鬼火环绕；将臣在下方握着发光断刀。
data.camera: full body, low angle, descending Murasame above Masaomi holding the broken sword
data.description: 穗织镇古老朝武神社的神木古殿前，神刀丛雨丸的断刃在将臣手中发出璀璨辉光。丛雨宛如被晨曦拂开的轻雾，从半空悠然旋转轻降。她一头浅草绿的长发与鲜红长发带如波浪翻卷，头顶呆毛欢快抖动。几团幽蓝色的青空鬼火环绕周身，她双手背后微微倾身，傲娇元气地自报家门——「呼啊~睡了太久身子都僵了呢！唤醒我辈的人，就是汝吗？」
data.lighting: 透过千年神木冠层洒落的金灿晨曦与身侧环绕的青蓝鬼火冷辉
data.location: 朝武神社神木大殿中庭
data.promptProse: The green-haired sword spirit Murasame floats down in her dark frilled kimono, both hands behind her back and blue spirit flames trailing her. Below her, short-haired Masaomi looks up from the broken Murasamemaru, which he holds at chest height over his pale short-sleeved shirt. Gold morning light filters through the shrine trees.
data.title: 丛雨 · 神刀复苏的空中轻降
data.animaCaption: Green-haired Murasame descends in her frilled spirit kimono with blue fire around her. Masaomi stands below in a pale short-sleeved shirt, his dark hair cropped short, holding the glowing broken blade at chest height.
